items.question: What is Rivet.Co?
items.answer: Rivet.Co is an Egyptian clothing brand making premium essentials: thoughtful design, clean silhouettes, considered details and quality fabrics.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Cairo & Giza: 1–3 business days. Other governorates: 2–5 business days. Delivery can take longer during sales, holidays or unexpected disruptions.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes. Orders over 1000 EGP ship free. See our Shipping Policy for details.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return items within 14 days of delivery. They must be unworn, unwashed and in their original condition with tags attached.

items.question: How do I exchange an item?
items.answer: Contact Customer Care and we'll walk you through it.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Visa, Mastercard, Meeza and Apple Pay.

items.question: Is my payment information secure?
items.answer: Yes. Payments are encrypted and processed by our licensed payment provider. Your card details never touch our website.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Once your order ships, we'll send you a message with tracking details.

items.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
items.answer: Yes, within 24 hours of placing it. Contact us right away if you need a change.

items.question: How do I contact Customer Support?
items.answer: Use our Contact page, email info@rivetcoeg.com, or message us on WhatsApp.
